content_sections.heading: About Embassy of India, Astana
content_sections.text: The Embassy of India in Astana is India's diplomatic mission in Kazakhstan. Its Administration Division, which handles this recruitment, is on the 10th Floor, 62 A, Kosmonavtov, Astana. The Marketing Assistant will work on the Embassy's trade and commercial work, including trade between India and Kazakhstan.

content_sections.heading: Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Embassy will also pay an annual bonus of one month's salary after you complete one year of service. Working with local trade organisations, associations and government Ministries on events for trade promotion, tourism, business conferences and similar work Writing reports on the Embassy's commercial events Collecting and analysing statistics on trade between India and Kazakhstan Replying to trade and commercial questions from Indian and Kazakh traders Translating and interpreting official documents Helping official delegations during their visits to Astana Any other suitable duties the Embassy gives FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.text: Age limit: Between 21 and 35 years. University Degree or equivalent Diploma Fluency (both oral and written) in English, Russian and Kazakh Good computer skills, including word processing, Excel, PowerPoint, Canva and email Good administrative, organisational and time management abilities Excellent communication skills Willingness to learn and develop new skills Specialisation in Marketing or Business Administration 3 to 5 years of previous experience in similar work Only candidates who hold a Local Work Permit, Resident Visa or similar document will be considered. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a full-time job. It becomes a permanent position once you complete probation. The place of work is the Embassy of India, Astana. You get 21 days of annual leave after completing one year of service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write a CV and a covering letter, both in English. Send them by post to: Administration Division, Embassy of India, 10th Floor, 62 A, Kosmonavtov, Astana, Kazakhstan. Or email them to [email protected] . Make sure your application reaches the Embassy by 14 November 2026. Documents to send: your CV and a covering letter in English.

faq.question: Q1. Which languages must I know for this post?
faq.answer: You must be fluent in English, Russian and Kazakh, both spoken and written.

faq.question: Q2. Can I send my CV by email?
faq.answer: Yes. You can email your CV and covering letter to [email protected] or post them to the Administration Division at the Embassy's Kosmonavtov address.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need a work permit to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates with a Local Work Permit, Resident Visa or similar document that allows them to work in foreign diplomatic missions under local rules will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Marketing Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: It is a full-time job that becomes permanent after you complete probation.

faq.question: Q5. Is a degree in Marketing compulsory?
faq.answer: No. A University Degree or equivalent Diploma in any subject is enough. A specialisation in Marketing or Business Administration is only preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Is work experience required?
faq.answer: No. Experience is not mandatory. The notice says 3 to 5 years of similar work would be desirable.

faq.question: Q7. What benefits come with the job besides the salary?
faq.answer: After one year of service, you get an annual bonus of one month's salary and 21 days of annual leave.

faq.question: Q8. Which computer skills are needed?
faq.answer: You need good skills in word processing, Excel, PowerPoint, Canva and email.

faq.question: Q9. When does the selected candidate start?
faq.answer: The post becomes vacant from 23 November 2026.
